_comment: Minted by the Julia reference binding's `run_pde_tests` (Tsit5, reltol=1e-12, abstol=1e-14). This golden is SHARED by the pair: `ic_param_override_rank3` carries the amplitude as an inline test's `parameter_overrides` and `ic_param_default_rank3` carries the SAME value as the parameter's declared `default`, so the two fixtures must reproduce it identically. That equality IS the gate -- a binding that drops an ic-only override from the build-time scope passes the default half and fails the override half.
